contracts: event.c owns the wevtapi.dll EvtIntAssertConfig hook
The internal export has no public Microsoft API page and local ABI evidence is the P_EvtIntAssertConfig typedef
The local typedef and detour both return BOOL
EvtApi_Init does not call SBIEDLL_HOOK unless GetProcAddress returned a non-null export pointer
The detour policy remains return success and clear last error
runtime_gate: Windows DLL build plus a wevtapi.dll load smoke on supported Windows versions proving EvtApi_Init succeeds when the export is present, fails cleanly when the export is absent, and the installed detour still returns success with GetLastError() == 0.
